Privacy & Cookie Policy

Welcome to Mont°6. We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data in compliance with EU Regulation 2016/679 (GDPR).

1. Data Controller

The controller of the personal data collected through this website is:
Daniele Gattuso
Cefalù, Sicily, Italy
Email: mont6.home@gmail.com

2. Personal Data Collected and Purposes

We collect and process the following data exclusively for the indicated purposes:

  • Booking Data: Dates of stay, number of guests, and contact details sent via WhatsApp or email. This data is used to manage availability and confirm bookings.
  • Payment Data: Online payment transactions are fully and securely handled by the third-party platform Stripe. We do not collect, store, or have access to your credit or debit card data. Transaction details are processed directly by Stripe to process payment in compliance with their security standards (PCI-DSS).

3. Legal Basis for Processing

We process your data based on the following conditions:

  • Performance of a contract or pre-contractual measures (to manage the booking request and the stay).
  • Compliance with legal obligations (e.g., reporting guests to the public safety authority "Alloggiati Web", managing regional and national taxes).

4. Data Retention

Personal data will be retained only for as long as strictly necessary to complete the purposes indicated above or to comply with legal tax or administrative record retention requirements.

5. Your Rights

You have the right at any time to request access to your data, their rectification, deletion, restriction of processing, or to object to their use. You can exercise these rights by sending an email to mont6.home@gmail.com.

6. Cookies and preferences

This website does not use third-party profiling or advertising tracking cookies (such as Facebook Pixel or Google Analytics).

The essential mont6_lang cookie remembers your language for one year. Local storage remembers that you dismissed the cookie notice; session storage keeps your selected dates and booking attempt identifier so you can resume the process without duplicating it.

Payment takes place on Stripe’s secure page, where Stripe manages its own security and fraud-prevention tools. The map loads images from OpenStreetMap, which receives technical request data such as your IP address.

Essential cookies do not require consent. We do not use optional cookies to accept or reject. You can clear site cookies and storage in your browser settings; this removes your saved preferences.

The site also uses Cloudflare Web Analytics to measure visits and performance, without cookies or local storage to track users. Read the privacy notices from Cloudflare, Stripe and OpenStreetMap.
